maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is subscription software (RMM, security, backup) sold to MSPs, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are MSPs and corporate IT departments paying for software subscriptions; end clients are private businesses.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through subscription software sales to MSPs, with occasional acquisitions such as Adlumin and Spinpanel.

mission_critical.reason: RMM, backup/disaster recovery and security operations are embedded in MSP workflows; switching means migration, retraining and risk.
